description: One row per prize the wheel can award. andy_weight controls odds; andy_remaining is finite stock, atomically decremented on claim. See power pages/PRIZE_ENGINE_SPEC.md §1/§2.1.

columns.description: Prize name, shown to the player and to booth staff.
Reference value -- reporting only, not read by the picker (§1.1).
Relative odds -- the field the picker actually uses (§1.2). Higher andy_value should mean lower andy_weight, by convention, not a formula.
Finite stock, decremented atomically on claim via ETag/If-Match (§1.3). Use a large number (e.g. 999999) for the fallback row -- see andy_isfallback.
Inactive prizes are excluded from selection entirely -- distinct from andy_remaining = 0, use this to retire a prize mid-event without it looking sold out.
Exactly one row should be true -- the empty-pool safety valve (§1.4). Excluded from normal weighted selection; only used when the eligible pool is empty. Validate exactly-one at deploy time.
Running counter, incremented alongside the andy_remaining decrement. Lets reporting show "claimed" even after andy_remaining hits 0. Starts at 0.
Optional reference image for booth staff / a future admin view.
